extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media relations professionals, members of the public seeking ADA press releases or expert contacts
extracted.subtask_description: A nonprofit newsroom page listing and categorizing the American Diabetes Association's press releases, official statements, local releases, and advocacy news, with expert contacts and procedures for obtaining older releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Get the latest news from the American Diabetes Association®, including press releases and research announcements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Site sections list recent press releases with headline, short excerpt, and a 'view' link to the full release. Example items: 'Registration Is Open for the American Diabetes Association’s 2026 Camps'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for formal organizational positions or reactions (examples on page: urging continued commitment to federal funding for diabetes research, statement on introduction of the INSULIN Act of 2026, praise for passage of appropriations bill). Presented in the 'Official Statement' category and shown as distinct from general press releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local Press Release
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local, event- or region-specific announcements (examples: Tour de Cure: Pacific Northwest; Step Out: Baltimore; Step Out: Tampa). The site groups and provides a 'View All Local Press Releases' link for these.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocacy News
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announcements focused on advocacy actions, policy positions, or recognition related to advocacy (examples: urging California lawmakers to restore access to obesity medications; applauding Virginia insulin-affordability legislation; naming an advocacy award recipient).

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release metadata (headline, excerpt, publish date, link)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listed item shows a headline, brief excerpt, publication type/category, and a 'view' link; individual releases display a publication date (e.g., 'Published: Thursday, May 7, 2026').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press materials on this site include clear metadata for readers and media: the release type (Press Release / Advocacy News / Local Press Release / Official Statement), short summary text, explicit published date, and a link to the full text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet Our Experts / Press Contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: The American Diabetes Association is proud to partner with leading experts in the field of diabetes and lists named experts (titles given).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For media inquiries or to speak to subject matter experts, the page provides a contact instruction: 'If you would like to speak to any of our subject matter experts, please contact us at [email protected].' This functions as the press-contact mechanism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for obtaining archival releases
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are looking for ADA press releases issued prior to 2019, please email [email protected].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Older press releases are not directly accessible on the site; the page instructs users to contact a provided email address to request pre-2019 press releases.
